desc: Ideation complete: separate the problem into per-window median cost computation and selection of k non-overlapping windows.
Implement a sliding-window median cost routine using coordinate compression and two Fenwick trees (counts and sums) to compute the minimum operations for every length-x subarray.
Implement the DP for selecting exactly k non-overlapping length-x windows from the precomputed window costs, allowing adjacent windows but forbidding overlap.
Handle indexing carefully so that window start/end positions and DP transitions are correct.
Run the provided sample tests and edge-case tests against the current implementation and report any failures.
Handle edge-case tests for small n, large x, negative values, duplicate values, and k*x == n.
Verify time and space complexity: O(n log n + k n) time and O(n) or O(k n) space depending on DP optimization.
